agricultural_data.modeling_scope: Provincial irrigated and rainfed palay records with usable production and harvested-area values.
agricultural_data.scope_note: ANI models canonical province-level records. Selected-city series are outside the provincial modeling unit. PSA notes that BARMM aggregate totals from Q1 2023 can include Eight Cluster Areas that are not separately assignable to a province; therefore sums of ANI provincial rows are not intended to reproduce PSA national or regional aggregate totals exactly.

agroclimatic_data.spatial_method: Nearest NASA POWER grid point to a representative provincial centroid.
agroclimatic_data.temporal_method_2026: Daily values aggregated to quarterly summaries; rainfall is summed and temperature, relative humidity, and wind speed are averaged.
agroclimatic_data.scope_note: Weather values are provincial-scale centroid approximations and are not province-area-weighted averages.

deployment_model.reason_for_cutoff: Q2 2026 agricultural source observations are preliminary and are retained as operational history rather than deployment fitting targets.

satellite_vegetation_data.access_platform: Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC and Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF assets
satellite_vegetation_data.quality_filter: Use MOD13A1 pixel-reliability values 0-1 and valid NDVI/EVI ranges; exclude 16-day composites that cross quarter boundaries.

cropland_mask.source: ESA Climate Change Initiative Land Cover

classes.12: Cropland, rainfed, tree or shrub cover

cropland_mask.temporal_policy: Use the preceding year's land-cover map where available; use 2020, the latest Planetary Computer ESA CCI annual map, for 2021 onward.

satellite_vegetation_data.spatial_aggregation: Mean of valid cropland-masked MODIS pixels within the frozen current DENR provincial boundary.

coverage.gap_policy: No synthetic or interpolated vegetation value is created. XGBoost candidate evaluation uses native missing-value handling.
coverage.gap_note: The Planetary Computer MODIS mirror used by this pipeline returned no Terra Q3 2025 items over the Philippines. NASA Earthdata CMR lists the corresponding MOD13A1 source granules; ANI therefore treats this as an access-platform mirror gap and leaves the quarter missing rather than silently mixing access sources or synthesizing values.

satellite_vegetation_data.historical_boundary_alignment: Pre-2024 current-boundary satellite values for Maguindanao del Sur are not joined to older agricultural records and are withheld during candidate model evaluation because those agricultural records represent the former undivided Maguindanao province. Standalone satellite seasonal context remains a current-boundary vegetation comparison independent of historical agricultural geography.
satellite_vegetation_data.deployment_use: Evaluated satellite vegetation dataset; not an input to the active deployed XGBoost model because the pre-specified promotion criteria were not met.

candidate_evaluation.decision: Retain the current deployed agricultural-plus-weather feature set.

system_context_use.seasonal_comparison: Compare the pre-target observation with earlier satellite observations from the same province and same calendar quarter.
system_context_use.seasonal_status_rule: Classify NDVI as below typical, within typical, or above typical relative to the historical 25th-75th percentile range.
system_context_use.model_relationship: Supporting context only; it does not alter XGBoost inference or yield-model eligibility.
system_context_use.missing_data_policy: Withhold satellite context when the required pre-target observation is unavailable; do not interpolate, synthesize, or block an otherwise valid yield estimate.

palay_market_context.source: Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) OpenSTAT Farm Price Survey for Palay
palay_market_context.geographic_scope: Provincial records available in the PSA matrix and aligned to ANI canonical province names.
palay_market_context.commodity_preference: Palay [Paddy] Other Variety, dry (conv. to 14% mc)
palay_market_context.model_relationship: Market context only; it is not an input to the active XGBoost model and does not alter yield-model eligibility or inference.
palay_market_context.availability_policy: Display the latest available provincial record and its explicit reference period; do not fabricate a value for months or provinces without a reported observation.

official_agri_weather_context.scope_note: Regional official agri-weather context. It is not a field-level forecast and does not replace official PAGASA warnings or advisories.
official_agri_weather_context.model_relationship: Context only; it is not an input to the active XGBoost model and does not alter yield-model eligibility or inference.

historical_yield_benchmarks.basis: Pre-target PSA agricultural history for the selected ecosystem and calendar quarter.
historical_yield_benchmarks.interpretation: Historical reference benchmarks only; not a universal or agronomic optimum.

associated_pre_target_signals.basis: Pre-target agricultural, NASA POWER seasonal history, and available MODIS vegetation context.
associated_pre_target_signals.interpretation: Associated conditions only; the system does not infer that an individual signal caused a yield change.

farmer_interpretation_layers.xgboost_relationship: These interpretation layers do not modify the trained feature vector, model artifact, fixed 2025 evaluation, or prediction output.

latest_enso_advisory.title: El Nino Advisory No. 5
latest_enso_advisory.scope: National PAGASA ENSO advisory. Local rainfall and agricultural impacts still depend on province-specific conditions and official local advisories.

official_climate_risk_context.scope_note: Official national/provincial climate-risk context. It is not a field-level diagnosis and does not replace PAGASA warnings, advisories, or LGU guidance.
official_climate_risk_context.model_relationship: Context only; it is not an input to the active XGBoost model and does not alter yield-model eligibility or inference.

historical_enso_yield_context.source: NOAA Climate Prediction Center Relative Oceanic Nino Index (RONI), ERSSTv6
displayed_context: historical El Nino, La Nina, and Neutral episode grouping
same-quarter median provincial palay yield by historical ENSO episode
historical_enso_yield_context.classification_method: El Nino and La Nina historical episode labels follow NOAA CPC's stated requirement that the +/-0.5 C RONI threshold persist for at least five consecutive overlapping seasons. Representative quarterly values use JFM, AMJ, JAS, and OND.
historical_enso_yield_context.model_relationship: Exploratory historical association only; RONI/ENSO is not an input to the active XGBoost model and does not alter prediction eligibility or inference.

evaluation.name: ANI Experimental Long-Term Climate-Analog Projection
evaluation.method: Five nearest historical climate analogs within the same province, ecosystem, and calendar quarter. Distances use median-absolute-deviation scaling across rainfall, mean temperature, relative humidity, and wind speed.
evaluation.validation_interpretation: The climate-analog method is less accurate than ANI's short-term previous-year seasonal baseline on the 2021-2025 check. It is therefore not presented as a replacement for the validated next-quarter XGBoost forecast. Its purpose is conditional long-term scenario exploration when future lagged agricultural inputs do not exist.

long_term_climate_projection.model_relationship: Experimental scenario projection only; CMIP6 is separate from the deployed next-quarter XGBoost model.
